manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.
